purpose: Single source of truth for which Layer D JSONL the GUI / runner / audit must read. v1 is the all-null placeholder (immutable provenance); v2 is the filled Chinese-aid file produced by an authorized real LLM run. v2 is NOT a second 150; it is the SAME 150 sample_ids with text_zh and back_translation_en filled.

must_satisfy_all: scripts/validate_layer_d_v2.py returns exit code 0 (150/150 record, 150/150 non-null text_zh and back_translation_en, model non-empty, prompt_sha256 non-empty, clauses+elements structurally valid, membership identical)
estg_150_human_correction_v1.json still 0/150 (user has not started editing); full file SHA-256 must match run_config.json's layer_e_sha256
data/input, data/gold, data/predictions, data/results are not written by the runner
must_not_happen: a third 150 sample_id set is created
user-entered human_correction data is migrated from one 150 to another
manual edit of active_path by hand (the promoter is the ONLY activation entry point)
silent overwrite of a v2 file that was activated by a different run_dir (the promoter refuses cross-run promotion unless the existing v2 is already byte-identical to the new run_dir's v2)
forbidden_actions: manual `cp` of the run_dir's layer_d_v2.jsonl into data/development/human_review/

active_filled_path_status_note: Until the user authorizes a real LLM run and validate_layer_d_v2.py returns 0 for 150/150, this config must keep active_path = placeholder_path. The GUI/audit/runner must read this file and never guess v1/v2. The activation metadata fields (active_run_dir / active_run_id / active_model / active_provider / active_base_url / active_v2_sha256 / active_manifest_sha256) are populated ONLY by scripts/promote_layer_d_v2.py; manual edits are forbidden.
